scopeNote: Left out as out of scope: art. 2 office floor area cap (75 m2) and social-housing shares (30 % / 25 %); art. 3 access-road widths (5 m) and gate recess (5 m from the alignment); art. 4 stormwater formula; art. 5 (characteristics of plots, not regulated, not a listed kind); art. 11 roof slopes (25-35 %), window proportions, awning and pillar sizes, fence and wall heights (0.50 m, 0.60, 0.80 m, 1.80 m); art. 12 parking (25 m2, 2.30 m, 1 place per 50 m2 / 25 m2); art. 14 cycle parking (0.75 / 1.5 / 3 m2, 1.5 %). Art. 6 setbacks from river and canal banks (zone UC: 20 m Eze, 20 m Ourgouse, 10 m other watercourses; UCa: 20 m Eze) were left out as not road or public-space setbacks. Described rules not listed: art. 6 and 7 'dispositions particulières' (extensions of non-compliant buildings, public-service technical works) and art. 7 annexes allowed on the side boundaries.
draftedBy: Claude Opus 5.5 (a subagent), from the written conventions of the evaluation set
draftNote: Drafted from the chapter's text before any model's reading of it, by a model that saw only the chapter, the conventions and the product's definitions (never another truth, never a reading). Held-out zone of another document and layout. Judgement calls of the drafter: Art. 6 setbacks from the banks of the Eze, the Ourgouse and other watercourses (20/20/10 m zone, 20 m UCa) were excluded as not road/public-space setbacks; a reader treating article 6 wholesale as road_setback would list them. | Each item of the art. 6 lists was taken as a separate rule (one per road with its own figure) instead of one rule per list sentence. | Art. 7 UCa: both cases (cas 1 on one side boundary with L = H-4 >= 4 m from the opposite one, cas 2 detached) listed as two UCa rules; cas 1 could be seen as an alternative not to list. | Art. 7 'Dans le reste de la zone UC' taken as sector null (the zone outside UCa); art. 8 and art. 10 name no sector, so listed only with sector null although they also bind UCa. | Art. 7 H read as an altitude difference ('différence de niveau'), reference altitude_difference, factor 1, offset -4, minimum 4. | Art. 10 annex ridge heights (3.5 m on the boundary within a 4 m depth, 4 m when at least 4 m away) listed as height_total; they apply to annexes only and the first holds within a 4 m strip, which the rule shape cannot carry.
validatedBy: independent cross-check (a second model, Fable 5.2, that did not see this truth) reconciled by Claude Code; not validated by the owner
